Title: Owner successfully posts job via /post-job page
Preconditions: User logged in as owner (role='owner'), backend running on port 9001
Steps: 1. Navigate to /post-job via nav link | 2. Fill title field with valid text | 3. Fill description textarea with project details | 4. Enter budget as positive number | 5. Select deadline date | 6. Enter comma-separated skills | 7. Click "Publish job" button
Test Data: Title: "Build responsive landing page" | Description: "Need a modern landing page with hero section and contact form" | Budget: 500 | Deadline: 2026-05-15 | Skills: "React, CSS, Responsive Design"
Expected Result: Form submits successfully, user redirected to / (browse page), new job appears at top of job list with status Open, no validation errors shown
